source_type: Official Oxford 3000 PDF grouped by CEFR, not a complete sense-by-sense EVP judgement
source_access: Direct PDF text inspection; page number is human 1-based and extracted_line is 0-based document text line as returned by the source viewer.
source_note: Oxford wordlist levels guide learning priorities; exact sense, register, part of speech, and possible alternate levels need human editorial verification. Not a CEFR authority signoff, not a copy of dictionary definitions.
official_pdf_transcription_false_positiv: an is listed in official A1 PDF but flagged absent by the community transcription; do not automatically treat absent as CEFR evidence.

records.shortlist_definition: Used before one person or thing when the next word starts with a vowel sound.
records.shortlist_burmese: တစ်ခု၊ တစ်ယောက် (သရသံဖြင့်စသော စကားလုံးရှေ့တွင်)
records.shortlist_example: She has an apple.
records.editorial_issue: Official PDF lists 'an' explicitly; secondary transcription's absent-word warning is a likely false positive.

records.shortlist_definition: Work involving buying, selling, or providing goods and services.
records.shortlist_burmese: စီးပွားရေးလုပ်ငန်း၊ ကုန်သွယ်မှု
records.shortlist_example: Her family runs a small business near the market.
records.editorial_issue: A2 draft versus A1 core noun; confirm business-as-enterprise sense and Myanmar gloss.

records.shortlist_definition: A group of musicians who perform together.
records.shortlist_burmese: တေးဂီတအဖွဲ့
records.shortlist_example: The band played at the school festival.
records.editorial_issue: B1 draft music-group sense versus A1 core noun; sense check required.

records.shortlist_definition: Details that identify where someone lives or a place is located.
records.shortlist_burmese: လိပ်စာ
records.shortlist_example: Please check the delivery address before confirming.
records.editorial_issue: B1 draft postal-address sense versus A1 core noun; check exact sense.

records.shortlist_definition: A person who is fully grown.
records.shortlist_burmese: အရွယ်ရောက်ပြီးသူ
records.shortlist_example: Every adult attending the workshop needs a ticket.
records.editorial_issue: B1 draft person noun versus A1 core noun; do not confuse A2 adjective.

records.shortlist_definition: The activity of promoting products or services to customers.
records.shortlist_example: Online advertising helped the shop attract customers.
records.editorial_issue: B2 draft promotion activity versus A2 core noun.

records.shortlist_definition: Pleasant to look at or appealing.
records.shortlist_example: The new packaging has an attractive design.
records.editorial_issue: B2 draft appealing adjective versus A2 core adjective.

records.shortlist_definition: The way in which someone or something moves or points.
records.shortlist_burmese: ဦးတည်ရာ၊ ဦးတည်ချက်
records.shortlist_example: The driver asked which direction to take.
records.editorial_issue: B1 draft movement direction versus A2 core noun.

records.shortlist_definition: To damage something so badly that it no longer exists or works.
records.shortlist_burmese: ဖျက်ဆီးသည်
records.shortlist_example: The fire destroyed the old warehouse.
records.editorial_issue: B2 draft versus A2 core verb; draft example uses inflected destroyed, not base form.

records.shortlist_definition: A person who works for an employer and receives pay.
records.shortlist_burmese: အလုပ်သမား၊ ဝန်ထမ်း
records.shortlist_example: Every employee must attend the safety briefing.
records.editorial_issue: B2 draft versus A2 core noun.

records.shortlist_definition: A person who designs or maintains machines, structures, or systems.
records.shortlist_burmese: အင်ဂျင်နီယာ
records.shortlist_example: The engineer inspected the damaged bridge.
records.editorial_issue: B2 draft versus A2 core noun.

records.shortlist_definition: The hard material that forms the trunk and branches of a tree.
records.shortlist_burmese: သစ်သား
records.shortlist_example: The carpenter made the table from wood.
records.editorial_issue: B1 draft material sense versus A2 core noun.

records.shortlist_definition: To feel anxious about a possible problem.
records.shortlist_burmese: စိုးရိမ်ပူပန်သည်
records.shortlist_example: Try not to worry about a small mistake.
records.editorial_issue: B1 draft anxiety verb versus A2 core verb.

records.shortlist_definition: Not worried, excited or upset.
records.shortlist_burmese: တည်ငြိမ်သော
records.shortlist_example: She remained calm during the emergency.
records.editorial_issue: B2 draft calm adjective versus B1 core adjective; B1 also lists other POS.

records.shortlist_definition: A person or organisation that pays for professional services.
records.shortlist_burmese: ဖောက်သည်
records.shortlist_example: The consultant met a new client.
records.editorial_issue: B2 draft professional-services customer versus B1 core noun.

records.shortlist_definition: An arranged time to meet someone, especially for a service or professional discussion.
records.shortlist_example: I made a dental appointment for Friday morning.
records.editorial_issue: B2 draft arranged meeting versus B1 core noun.

records.shortlist_definition: The process of judging the quality or value of something.
records.shortlist_burmese: အကဲဖြတ်ခြင်း
records.shortlist_example: The final assessment includes a written test.
records.editorial_issue: B2 draft aligns with Oxford B2 noun at word/POS level; exact sense still unverified.

records.shortlist_definition: A serious illness in which some cells in the body grow without control.
records.shortlist_burmese: ကင်ဆာရောဂါ
records.shortlist_example: The doctor explained how cancer treatment works.
records.editorial_issue: B1 draft disease sense versus B2 core noun.

records.shortlist_definition: A plan for how much money can be spent over a period or on a task.
records.shortlist_burmese: အသုံးစရိတ်အစီအစဉ်၊ ဘတ်ဂျက်
records.shortlist_example: We prepared a budget before starting the project.
records.editorial_issue: B1 draft financial plan versus B2 core noun.

records.shortlist_definition: To stop supporting or continuing a plan or activity.
records.shortlist_burmese: စွန့်လွှတ်သည်၊ ဆက်မလုပ်တော့ဘဲ ရပ်တန့်သည်
records.shortlist_example: The organisers had to abandon the outdoor event because of the storm.
records.editorial_issue: C1 draft stop-continuing sense versus B2 core verb.

records.shortlist_definition: To accept or recognise that a fact or problem exists.
records.shortlist_burmese: အချက်အလက် သို့မဟုတ် ပြဿနာတစ်ခု ရှိကြောင်း အသိအမှတ်ပြုသည်
records.shortlist_example: The report must acknowledge the limits of the survey.
records.editorial_issue: C1 draft accept-fact sense versus B2 core verb.

records.shortlist_definition: The end of a person's or animal's life.
records.shortlist_example: The family was deeply saddened by his death.
records.editorial_issue: A2 draft matches Oxford A2 noun at word/POS level; exact sense still unverified.

records.shortlist_definition: Used before one person or thing when it is not specified.
records.shortlist_burmese: တစ်ခု၊ တစ်ယောက် (မသတ်မှတ်ရသေးသော)
records.shortlist_example: I have a book.
records.editorial_issue: A1 draft matches official A1 indefinite article; no independent English/Myanmar signoff.
